blocks.text: A lucky lotto player is now ₱21.69 million richer after winning the jackpot prize in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office’s (PCSO) Lotto 6/42 draw held on October 29, 2026. He claimed his prize at the PCSO Main office in Mandaluyong on November 3,2026. The winner correctly matched the winning combination 34-15-19-37-25-38, taking home a total jackpot prize of ₱21,694,699.03 through a Lucky Pick bet.
